foot_tagline: Free AI from {{providers}} providers, on your own computer. Open source, single-user, no accounts.
foot_note: For personal use. Each provider's terms apply. Never share your endpoint or keys. Not affiliated with any AI provider.
limit_tpd_max: up to {n} tokens a day per model
limit_rpd_max: up to {n} requests a day per model
standard_terms: Standard free tier; see the provider's terms.
th_what_to_know: What to know before you use it
keyless_text: No account or key needed: FreeAITokens uses {name} straight away.
openrouter_connect: Easiest: in the FreeAITokens app choose Add a provider… → OpenRouter and approve the connection in your browser. No copying needed.
paste_key: Then paste the key into FreeAITokens: Add a provider… in the app, or npx freeaitokens add.
providers_desc: All {n} free AI providers FreeAITokens works with, their free limits, and how to get a free key for each.
providers_lead: FreeAITokens works with {n} AI providers. {k} need no account; for the rest, a free key takes a minute. Each one adds to your free total.
read_notes: Read each provider's notes before you sign up:
provider_desc: {name} on FreeAITokens: {n} models, its free limits, and how to get a free API key.
use_chat: You don't pick chat models: FreeAITokens chooses the best free model that fits each request and moves to another when one runs out. This one is used when it fits and has free capacity.
use_media: Send {model} as the model to always use this one; otherwise FreeAITokens picks a free model of this type for you. See Not only chat.
model_desc: {id} from {name}: context, features and free limits on FreeAITokens.
models_desc: All {n} free AI models FreeAITokens can use, with filters for provider, type, tool calling, images and context size.
models_lead: Chat, transcription, text to speech, images and embeddings, from the model families you already know.
js_also: Also for {list} · free and open source
og_alt: FreeAITokens: billions of free AI tokens a month from many providers, in one app
mob_lead: Chat, make images and turn speech into text on iPhone and Android, with the same free models. Nothing is hosted in between: your phone talks straight to the providers with your own keys, or to FreeAITokens on your computer.
